note: MyDesk Infra provides conceptual infrastructure planning, DEM terrain interpolation, component roads, corridor earthworks, bridges, and city model generation targeting Autodesk InfraWorks. Capabilities remain scoped FUNCTIONAL subsets, not complete product parity.

capabilities.name: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) terrain interpolation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Import gridded digital elevation models with bilinear surface interpolation across projected coordinates.
capabilities.expected_input: DEM grid and sample query coordinates
capabilities.expected_output: Continuous ground elevation at arbitrary easting/northing
capabilities.differences: Bilinear elevation interpolation across gridded raster cells.

capabilities.name: Parametric component roads and centerline geometry
capabilities.reference_behavior: Design component roads with multi-lane cross sections, design speeds, and stations.
capabilities.expected_input: 3D centerline vertices, lane width, and speed
capabilities.expected_output: Evaluated road length and alignment geometry
capabilities.differences: Component road length and centerline stations verified.

capabilities.name: Parametric bridge structures and piers
capabilities.reference_behavior: Place bridge spans across terrain depressions with pier placement along road alignments.
capabilities.expected_input: Road reference, start/end stations, pier count

capabilities.name: 3D draped city buildings and usage zoning
capabilities.reference_behavior: Extrude 3D building polygons draped on terrain with functional occupancy categories.
capabilities.expected_input: Footprint boundary polygon, height, and usage
capabilities.expected_output: 3D urban building draped at ground elevation

capabilities.name: GeoJSON spatial feature collection interchange
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export infrastructure roads and polygons to standard GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
capabilities.differences: GeoJSON LineString and Polygon features verified.

capabilities.name: Native project serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and reopen .myinfra native documents preserving DEM, roads, and metadata.
capabilities.performance: Atomic temporary-file replacement with a 256 MiB guarded reader
capabilities.differences: Versioned schema and complete DEM, road, bridge, and building round trips are verified; unknown-field preservation and recovery journaling remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Terrain-aware road corridor cut and fill analysis
capabilities.reference_behavior: Sample a component road by station, compare its formation surface with terrain, and report profile grades plus cut and fill quantities.
capabilities.expected_input: Persisted road alignment, DEM terrain, shoulder width, and longitudinal/transverse sampling intervals
capabilities.expected_output: Station samples, terrain and design elevations, grades, cross-section areas, and cut/fill volumes
capabilities.performance: Linear in station count multiplied by transverse samples
capabilities.differences: Constant-width level formation and DEM terrain are supported; superelevation, daylight side slopes, strata, and haul balancing remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Persistent infrastructure browser, 3D context viewport, properties, history, and files
capabilities.reference_behavior: A standalone infrastructure workspace creates, selects, visualizes, edits, analyzes, saves, reopens, and exports the implemented terrain, road, bridge, and building model subset.
capabilities.expected_input: Procedural DEM, component road, bridge, city building, and road property edit
capabilities.expected_output: Selectable 3D context model; property edit survives redo and native reopen; GeoJSON contains the project feature collection
capabilities.performance: CPU conceptual viewport is tested with a 21x21 DEM and small feature sets.
capabilities.differences: No GIS/raster import, coordinate transformation, proposal comparison, road grip editing, production labels, cloud collaboration, or large-model GPU renderer.
